messages:
maria_chen: Heads-up — Vireo Labs (tenant vireo-481) opened a ticket: console 403 and model calls failing after today's RBAC migration. Customer says billing page empty and inference returns permission_denied.

nora_support: Customer repro steps: sign in -> /org/dashboard returns 403, GET /v1/models -> 403, embeddings -> 403 with "rpc error: code = PermissionDenied". They provided a support bundle.

alex_kaplan: Can someone paste the API gateway and KMS unwrap logs from the bundle? Need to know if it's missing role mapping or a KMS ACL drop.

maria_chen: Pasting minimal redacted logs from their bundle:
```
2026-05-03T14:59:03Z INFO request tenant=vireo-481 user=alice@vireo.com path=/v1/models/list status=403 reason=rbac:policy_evaluate:DENY
2026-05-03T14:59:04Z WARN kms unwrap tenant=vireo-481 key=vireo-data-key err=\"permission denied: iam.serviceAccounts/vireo-svc not found in binding\"
```

jordan_sre: That looks like two failures: 1) role graph evaluation returning DENY for tenant principals, 2) KMS unwrap failing because the tenant service account lost the cryptoKeyDecrypter binding. Could be the role migration script pruned bindings.

linh_ops: The rollout moved attribute mapping from `org_role` -> `role_set` and consolidated writer/read into editor in the role model. Our cleanup pass attempted to remove legacy bindings when no mapping matched; there's a bug where tenant-scoped SAs were treated as orphaned and had bindings removed.

sam_security: Impact P2 (customer-facing, blocked). Triage plan: 1) confirm role_graph for vireo-481 2) inspect IAM delta for key vireo-data-key 3) temporarily apply least-priv bind to restore service SA 4) prepare audit + revert.

nora_support: Customer approved a temporary backfill if we can restore access quickly.

alex_kaplan: Ran a quick query against the role_graph DB:
```
SELECT principal, effective_roles FROM role_graph WHERE tenant='vireo-481';
-- result: principal=serviceAccount:vireo-svc@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com effective_roles=[reader]
-- previous expected roles: [model-infer, billing-reader, reader]
```

maria_chen: So model inference and billing views would be missing with only reader. That aligns with the errors.

jordan_sre: Checked cloud IAM change log for the crypto key: the binding for `serviceAccount:vireo-svc@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` -> roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter was removed at 15:05 UTC in the deployment window. The policy delta matches the refactor job run.

linh_ops: Confirmed: the cleanup step in the migration script removed SA key bindings when the mapping routine returned empty. That's the bug. We'll stop the cleanup step and make it log-only while we backfill.

sam_security: Remediation: re-add KMS binding and backfill role_graph for the SA. Jordan — can you rebind the key with least privilege?

jordan_sre: I can do it now. Applying: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter to serviceAccount:vireo-svc@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com on projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/vireo/cryptoKeys/vireo-data-key. Also adding role `model-infer` to role_graph for the SA as a temporary patch.

nora_support: Please notify the customer before making changes.

jordan_sre: Notified customer via support thread and proceeding after ack.

system: deploy-bot: rollback job #deploy-2026-05-03-rbac-rc3 initiated for role-refactor service (reason: emergency cleanup removal).

alex_kaplan: After rebind + role_graph backfill, quick smoke: 
```
# as alice@vireo.com
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer <alice-token>\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/list
-> 200 OK (models payload)

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer -d '{"model":"gpt-3.5-rd","input":"test"}'
-> 200 OK (inference)
```

maria_chen: Customer confirms console loads, billing page shows entries, and embedding call succeeded. They asked for a short postmortem and assurance this won't recur.

linh_ops: Root cause summary: migration cleanup erroneously dropped tenant-scoped SA IAM bindings when attribute mapping returned no match. Fixes: 1) remove destructive cleanup from the migration job and make it log-only 2) add a targeted backfill for tenants in the 15:00-15:15 UTC window 3) add canary tests covering SA->KMS unwrap and role_graph migration paths 4) add telemetry alert when >0 SA KMS bindings are removed in a single tenant run.

sam_security: Also add verification steps in the release playbook: pre-migration snapshot of SA bindings, dry-run validation, and a fast rollback plan.

nora_support: Filing customer follow-up ticket and scheduling postmortem delivery.

alex_kaplan: Created GH issue redwood/infra#4321 with mitigation checklist: backfill script, canary tests, alerting, migration script patch.

jordan_sre: Applying final checks and closing incident once watchers ack. :white_check_mark: 

linh_ops: ack
sam_security: ack
maria_chen: ack
nora_support: ack
deploy-bot: rollback job #deploy-2026-05-03-rbac-rc3 completed (status: success)

vireo-alice: Thank you, team — access restored and billing data looks good. Appreciate the quick fix.
